title: Scan Repair Local
user: Readers and researchers with scanned books or archival PDFs who need usable text without uploading sensitive material.
smallest_useful_product: Offline desktop/PWA tool that detects skew/blur/contrast, previews reversible repairs, runs local OCR, and exports searchable PDF plus Markdown with page references.
constraints: Keep files on device by default; preserve originals; clearly label OCR uncertainty; do not imply archival-grade accuracy.
